blocks.content: Graph traversal is the process of visiting every vertex (node) in a graph. It is also known as graph search.
Graph is a non-linear data structure. Therefore, there is no straightforward way to traverse a graph.
In this course, we will discuss two of the possible graph traversal methods.
Let's start with the DFS algorithm first, and then move on to BFS in the next lesson.
